text_block_list.text:
One day, just as I finished Maruzensky's 
training session, it started to rain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer-kun. Got some time after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer-chan. Got some time 
after this?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking while driving in the 
rain... how fun it would be to go for a 
run on a day like this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Splashing water rising up, obstructed 
visibility... They say in times like that, 
you can feel a special wind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could run with super high 
energy today! It'd be such a waste to end 
practice now♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Running in the pouring rain has its own 
charm, too♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Something like this is basically like 
taking a morning shower. Though since it's 
evening, an evening shower...?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My body's still burning up—there's no 
stopping me now. My real performance is 
just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit! We're running all 
night long!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, looks like the sky is delighted 
too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, to a world of wind that pierces 
through even raindrops!

And so, in the pouring rain, the extra 
training dragged on endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a shame. And here we had such a 
great opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, nothing to be done about it. 
Conserving stamina is important too, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It'd be awful if I ended up giving 
Trainer-kun a cold, after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It'd be awful if I ended up giving 
Trainer-chan a cold, after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As a substitute, come along for a drive in 
the rain with me. Just the two of us, 
okay?♪

Though utterly exhausted from driving in 
the rain, Maruzensky seemed to have 
thoroughly enjoyed herself.
